text: Get {target} to say "No way!" out loud.
Start a slow clap to celebrate something tiny and get at least two people to join in.
Get {target} to say the word "spaghetti" without you saying it first.
Use the word "magnificent" three times in one conversation.
Fake a sneeze and get {target} to say "Bless you."
Move a pillow to the other side of the room without anyone seeing you do it.
Get {target} to ask you "Why are you smiling?"
Speak only in questions for one full minute of conversation.
Get {target} to tell you "You're right" about anything at all.
Get everyone to vote on which snack gets opened next.
Get {target} to whisper something to you.
Get a "One more game!" chant going with at least three people chanting.
Ask {target} weird questions until they say "I've never thought about that."
Hum the same tune on and off until someone asks what song it is.
Make a deal with {target} about anything and get them to say "Deal."
Tell a story that includes a llama, a toaster and a trampoline, start to finish.
Steer a conversation until {target} says the word "volcano."
End three sentences in a row with "...allegedly."
Get {target} to high-five you three separate times within ten minutes.
Invent a holiday and get two people to tell you how they'd celebrate it.
Invent a secret handshake with {target} and do it together twice.
Line up all the snacks in a perfectly straight row without anyone noticing.
Get {target} to play best two out of three at rock-paper-scissors with you.
Give a random household object a name and a backstory, and get someone to ask about it.
Get {target} to bring you a glass of water without asking them for it directly.
Narrate yourself picking a spot to sit like a nature documentary host.
Get {target} to switch spots with you without telling them why.
React to three ordinary things in a row by saying "Plot twist!"
Trade one of your snacks for one of {target}'s.
Get the group to agree on a team name for the night.
Get {target} to agree that cereal counts as soup.
Answer the next three yes-or-no questions you get with "Affirmative" or "Negative."
Get {target} to rank three snacks from best to worst out loud.
Talk only in a whisper for five minutes without explaining why.
Get {target} to give you a nickname, then get them to use it again later.
Start a stadium wave and get everyone who's awake to do it.
Make up a catchphrase and get {target} to say it without you prompting them.
Leave a spoon somewhere strange and wait for someone to ask why it's there.
Find out which superpower {target} would pick without asking about superpowers.
Stare at the ceiling until someone else looks up too.
Get {target} to describe their perfect sandwich in detail.
Start a debate about whether a straw has one hole or two.
Get {target} to draw you a quick doodle of a cat.
Get at least two people to sing Happy Birthday to the snack bowl.
Tell {target} the cheesiest joke you know and get them to laugh anyway.
Challenge someone to a staring contest and win.
Get {target} to teach you something they're good at.
Win a thumb war against anyone.
Get {target} to give you a thumbs-up from across the room.
Ask the room a riddle and give no hints until someone solves it.
Get {target} to make a wish with you when the clock shows matching numbers, like 11:11.
Start a one-word-at-a-time story and get it all the way around the room.
Get {target} to read the back of a snack bag out loud to you.
Wear a blanket like a superhero cape for five minutes like it's totally normal.
Without {target} noticing, copy the way they're sitting three different times.
Share a made-up fun fact so confidently that someone believes it, then come clean.
Plan a pretend snack heist with {target}, step by step.
Get two people to do their best animal sound.
Get {target} to help you come up with a name for a made-up band.
Sit in four different spots within ten minutes without anyone commenting on it.
Tell {target} about your imaginary pet and get them to suggest its name.
Make your next three sentences rhyme without anyone noticing.
Get {target} to do a dramatic countdown from ten with you for no reason.
Write "TOP SECRET" on a scrap of paper, fold it, and get someone to open it.
Get {target} to agree to be on your team for the next game.
Make up a password and get someone to say it before you hand them anything.
Get {target} to play a round of I Spy with you.
Give everyone in the room a superhero name and get one person to use theirs.
Get {target} to ask to borrow something of yours.
Get the whole room silent at the same time for ten seconds.
Get {target} to tell you which animal they'd be and why.
Gasp like you just remembered something, then say "Never mind." Do it three times.
Get {target} to pinky-promise you something silly.
Refer to yourself in the third person for five minutes.
Get {target} to try a tongue twister three times fast.
Start a "this or that" lightning round and get three people answering.
Start tapping a beat and get {target} to join in.
Call the room "Headquarters" until someone else calls it that too.
Teach {target} a silly victory pose and get them to do it.
Stretch dramatically before doing something tiny, like picking up the TV remote.
Yawn near {target} until they yawn too.
Describe a snack's flavor like a fancy food critic until someone laughs.
Get {target} to guess how many pillows are in the whole house.
Give three different people a real compliment about something they said or did.
Get {target} to fold a paper airplane with you.
Bring up penguins in three different conversations without anyone asking why.
Get {target} to name three things they'd bring to a desert island.
Use a made-up word in conversation until someone asks what it means.
Get {target} to say your name in their best robot voice.
Get at least two people to help you build a blanket fort.
Agree on a secret signal with {target} and use it once without anyone noticing.
Get three different people to tell you what time it is.
